solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Single day after middle of June

indicators.note: the day's abbreviation is placed following the central letters
only the central pair of letters of the month's name is taken

parts.note: WED is the short form of Wednesday

explanation.surface: Someone is still single the day after mid-June.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone single has not married, so the adjective is a straight synonym.

clue.text: Like protesters, well versed on weaponry?

parts.note: to be up in a subject is to know it well
arms are weapons

explanation.surface: Asks whether protesters are knowledgeable about weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Protesters are angry and indignant, which is the idiom's meaning; the literal reading suits weaponry too.

clue.text: Cleaner more prudent after change of heart

indicators.note: the central letter of the comparative is swapped for a different one

parts.note: wiser means more prudent

explanation.surface: A cleaner turns more prudent after changing their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change of heart' swaps the middle letter S of WISER for P.
explanation.definitionFit: A windscreen blade or cloth that wipes is a cleaner of a sort.

clue.text: Girl calmer — one's producing a whisky?

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name
stiller means calmer

explanation.surface: A girl is calmer, perhaps after producing a whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Whisky makers run stills, so a producer of the spirit is described by its maker's title.

clue.text: Plant needing air after feeding with double nitrogen

indicators.note: the atmosphere word has the paired element symbols fed into its middle

parts.note: a place's feel is its air or atmosphere

indicators.note: the element symbol is taken twice over

parts.note: N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A plant needs air once it has been fed a double dose of nitrogen fertiliser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air' here means a sense or atmosphere, not breathable gas; 'double' doubles the nitrogen symbol before it is fed in.
explanation.definitionFit: Fennel is an aniseed-flavoured herb, an example of a plant.

clue.text: Deer trapped in park leapt up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top
the letters sit inside the words park leapt, held across the gap

explanation.surface: A deer caught in a park jumped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trapped in' gives KLE from parK LEapt; 'up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The elk is a large species of deer, so the relation is an example.

clue.text: Rue tent disturbing this in the garden?

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Something in the garden upsets a tent.
explanation.definitionFit: A hazel or walnut grown for its crop is a typical garden tree, so the definition hints at an example.

clue.text: Places to lounge about, reportedly

indicators.note: the word for idling is said out loud and heard as another word

parts.note: to laze is to lounge about

explanation.surface: Somewhere to lounge around, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Places' is a verb here, not the noun it looks like.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay something down is to put or set it, a verb synonym in the third person.

clue.text: Boast stereo: fantastic thing for child in car

indicators.note: something fantastic is wildly fanciful, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: Bragging about a superb car stereo bought for a child's ride.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised cushion lets a small child sit high enough for a seatbelt, so it is that thing.

clue.text: Ma's top I replaced, putting on thick coat

indicators.note: the letters are put back in a different order

explanation.surface: Mum's top was replaced and a heavy coat put on instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is paint laid on so heavily that brush marks stand out, a thick coat.

clue.text: Tom, perhaps, shared fund

definitions.meaning: a tom is a male cat, a pet word for which this is
a pool of money contributed jointly

explanation.surface: Tom contributes to the communal pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet name for a cat, and also the pooled money in a card game or office collection.

clue.text: Scottish resort where Ray's gone off

indicators.note: having gone off means turned bad, so the name is rearranged

parts.note: the name Ray, its 's standing for has

explanation.surface: The Scottish seaside town where Ray has left for.
explanation.walkthrough: Ayr is a seaside town on Scotland's west coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Ayr is a holiday town on the Firth of Clyde, an example of a Scottish resort.

clue.text: Popular drinks, we hear, for those in the know

indicators.note: the phrase is heard rather than read, so the spelling changes

parts.note: being in means being popular or fashionable; ciders are apple drinks

explanation.surface: Fashionable drinks are said to be for people with inside knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: People within an organisation have privileged information, so they are in the know.

clue.text: Tyranny of the French Petty Officer: it upset sergeant major

parts.note: des is French for of the (plural)
PO is the naval abbreviation for petty officer

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the little word upside down

parts.note: SM is the military abbreviation for sergeant major

explanation.surface: A French petty officer's tyranny upset the sergeant major.
explanation.definitionFit: Despotism is rule by an absolute, oppressive ruler, a synonym for tyranny.

clue.text: For one new, an act of goodwill

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a favour is a kind deed

explanation.surface: One newcomer does a kind deed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be for a proposal is to support it, so the phrase is a synonym.

clue.text: From Turkey to Iran, maybe, represented by me in capitals?

definitions.text: From Turkey to Iran, maybe, represented by me in capitals?

parts.words: From Turkey to Iran, maybe, represented by me in capitals?
parts.note: the region spanning these countries is abbreviated as the two capital letters M E

explanation.surface: A traveller describes a route across the capitals between Turkey and Iran.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capitals' looks like cities but means capital letters: ME is the standard short form of the region's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Turkey and Iran lie in the region of south-west Asia, so things there are described by its adjective.

clue.text: Deny Ovid was needing translation

indicators.note: translating changes the form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone denies that the Roman poet Ovid needed translating.
explanation.definitionFit: To disavow is to refuse to acknowledge, a synonym for deny.

clue.text: Strong coffee and tablets journalists love

parts.note: ES is slang for ecstasy tablets, E being one pill
the press means journalists collectively
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Reporters adore strong coffee and pills.
explanation.definitionFit: Espresso is a concentrated shot of coffee forced through with steam, so it is strong.

clue.text: A US lawyer's high-level language

parts.note: DA is a district attorney in America

explanation.surface: An American lawyer uses lofty language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high-level' is computing jargon, not elevated speech: Ada is a programming language.
explanation.definitionFit: Ada is a programming language of the kind computer scientists call high-level.

clue.text: Gather confession from fool?

parts.note: a fool owning up says 'I am', supplying the verb
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: Asks whether a gathering produced a confession from a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: The fool's confession is 'I am an ass', boiled down to the two words of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to collect or accumulate, so gather is a synonym.

clue.text: From TV doctor, a directive to slow down

parts.note: Doctor Who is the long-running BBC science-fiction series

explanation.surface: A TV doctor tells someone to ease up.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor Who is a long-running British TV show about a time-travelling doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: The call is used to halt a horse or tell someone to stop and slow down.

clue.text: Consume last of open port

parts.note: to have food is to consume it

indicators.note: only the final letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: Eat the last of what's open at the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A haven is a harbour or safe anchorage, a synonym for port.

clue.text: Not quite enough river for a duck

indicators.note: the river falls one letter short, losing its last

parts.note: the Nile is the African river

explanation.surface: There is not quite enough river for a duck to swim in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' is cricket's word for a score of zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A batter out for nothing scores a duck in cricket, and nothing is zero.

clue.text: Operetta's ending: it got a fresh musical direction

indicators.note: only the final letter of the light opera is used
a fresh version is a new arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: The end of a light opera received a new musical marking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fresh' turns IT GOT A into GITATO.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitato tells the player to perform in an agitated, restless way, so it is a tempo marking.

clue.text: Too springlike?

definitions.meaning: a well is a spring, so like one

explanation.surface: Is that excessively vernal too?
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means also; read literally, it says like a water source, a spring.

clue.text: Skinflint's unhappiness never-ending

indicators.note: the word for unhappiness loses its final letter

parts.note: misery is unhappiness

explanation.surface: The penny-pincher's unhappiness goes on forever.
explanation.definitionFit: A miser hoards money and hates spending it, the same as a skinflint.
